# ValueTable

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:value-table` · Kerf UI · component · Structure

Key/value rows with optional icons.

## When to use

Key/value rows with optional icons and aligned separators.

- Present read-only label/value facts as a semantic definition list, optionally with a 24px leading icon.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for editable fields or row/column tabular data.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/value-table` — exports `ValueTable`, `ValueTableRow`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/value-table` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/value-table.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/value-table`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuivalue-table) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- icon rows
- iconless rows
- compact density
- placeholder (loading)

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** values; formatting; empty policy.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: self · border: self · padding: self (layout role: structure). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Name ValueTable with its label; ValueTableRow supplies dt/dd semantics, and row icons stay decorative unless meaning requires an accessible label.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-value-table`, `kui-value-table__row`, `kui-value-table__icon`, `kui-value-table__label`.

Never put `kui-value-table`, `kui-value-table__row`, `kui-value-table__icon`, `kui-value-table__label` on an element you write; render `ValueTable` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-color-neutral-border-normal`, `--kui-color-surface-lowered`, `--kui-color-text`, `--kui-font-weight-semibold`, `--kui-layout-inline-margin`, `--kui-layout-item-gap`, `--kui-layout-item-padding`, `--kui-space-2xs`, `--kui-value-table-background`, `--kui-value-table-border`, `--kui-value-table-icon-size`, `--kui-value-table-row-columns`, `--kui-value-table-row-padding-block`, `--kui-value-table-row-gap`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
